commonStageExitGates: All26 original firstWork identities and canonical JSON row digests preserved; immutable source and predecessor artifacts checked.

implicitEuler.selectedImplementation: adaptive full plus two half implicit Euler steps; bounded finite-difference Newton with line search

analysisUiContract.expressionGradient: Actual five bounded AST evaluations, central h/h2 finite differences and Richardson derivative; nonsmooth source rejected.
analysisUiContract.modelResolution: Two actual continuous solver runs on one output observation grid; fine initial/max step divided by ratio2..8; immutable source snapshot; bounded cancellation.
analysisUiContract.localLinearization: Actual continuous definition Jacobians A/B/C/D at explicit operating point, exactly four bus fields; independent alternative.
